Are my photos uploaded or saved?

Not in this demo. Your photo is displayed only in your browser. The planned generation service will ask for consent before upload and provide a deletion option.

Can I use any pet or character image?

The intended launch will focus on clear photos of pets, plushies, and characters. Use images you own or have permission to use. This prototype does not yet generate custom pet assets.

Can I pay and download my pet now?

Not yet. This is a product and interaction prototype. Real generation, accounts, licenses, payments, and Windows downloads are not connected to this page.
